deal.name: Feedback Link
deal.tagline: Get reviews & testimonials from happy customers, survey the rest. Display Social Proof on your site.

plans.name: Single
terms: You must redeem your code within 60 days of purchase
Please note: This deal is not stackable
features: Collect testimonials, shares, or reviews on 8 different platforms
Automatically send Email/Text requests by integrating with software you already use
Up to five locations per brand, each with their own feedback link, collaborators and configuration
Use your own domain or subdomain for your survey
Create up to 10 Social Proof widgets, showcase your reviews, and feedback on your site
Import reviews from Facebook, Google, Trustpilot, Yelp, Foursquare, Tripadvisor
Fully custom-branded survey, no Feedback Link logo
Know your Net Promoter Score, or measure satisfaction with Star-rating or Smileys (CSAT)
6 Professionally translated languages (translated by native speakers)
Invite collaborators to work on your account
Funnel unhappy customers directly to you
Collect testimonials, reviews and shares from delighted customers

signals.label: Lifetime definition
signals.finding: The vendor may discontinue the product, which ends a lifetime deal.

evidence.quote: We also reserve the right to modify or discontinue all or part of the Site without notice at any time.

signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: Invites are email + text (SMS) from one shared monthly pool. Sending texts also uses SMS credit packs — from $9 per 500 credits ($9/500, $29/2,000, $69/5,000, $119/10,000).
Free accounts are not charged and include limited monthly usage, as described on our pricing page, until upgraded to a paid subscription.

signals.label: Support complaints
signals.finding: 5 reviews (7.2% of all) say support is slow or gone.

evidence.quote: I haven't heard back from support even though their chat widget says they'll respond in a few hours.
I have been trying to get support or even documentation. There is NONE.
I then emailed Feedback Link support, but after more than a week, NO RESPONSE from them either.

signals.label: Review trend
signals.finding: Newest 20 reviews average 3.65/5 vs 4.48/5 all-time (-0.83). 10% of all reviews are 1-2 stars.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $79 vs a stated $1656 regular price (95% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

evidence.quote: We reserve the right, in our sole discretion, to make changes or modifications to these Terms of Use from time to time.
We may change prices at any time. All payments shall be in __________.

trials.claim: Collect testimonials, shares, or reviews on 8 different platforms
trials.claimQuote: Collect testimonials, shares, or reviews on 8 different platforms
trials.reasoning: The defense exhibit names only Google, Facebook, and Trustpilot plus '& more,' which does not show 8 different platforms.

exhibits.quote: Every customer can also be asked for an online review — on the platforms you choose (Google, Facebook, Trustpilot & more).
exhibits.argument: Vendor states customers can be asked for reviews on chosen platforms including Google, Facebook and Trustpilot.

trials.claim: Up to five locations per brand with own feedback link and configuration
trials.claimQuote: Up to five locations per brand, each with their own feedback link, collaborators and configuration
trials.reasoning: The same review only mentions different survey flows through locations and wishes for different links under one business name; it does not show up to five locations per brand each with its own link and configuration.

exhibits.quote: I'm glad that it is possible to have different survey flows through the locations option in settings, although I would rather just have different links and flows connected to one business name rather than having to use variations on my business name.
exhibits.argument: The quote shows locations require workarounds with variations on the business name rather than clean separate links per brand.

exhibits.quote: I'm glad that it is possible to have different survey flows through the locations option in settings, although I would rather just have different links and flows connected to one business name rather than having to use variations on my business name.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms locations option provides different survey flows and links per location.

trials.claimQuote: Automatically send Email/Text requests by integrating with software you already use
trials.reasoning: One review says emails and SMS are not delivered while another says they are sent effectively, and no exhibit shows automatic sending by integrating with software you already use.

exhibits.quote: Sending texts also uses SMS credit packs — from $9 per 500 credits ($9/500, $29/2,000, $69/5,000, $119/10,000).
exhibits.argument: The quote shows text requests cost extra credit packs beyond the subscription.

exhibits.quote: Totally useless, since emails and SMS messages aren't delivered.
exhibits.argument: The quote reports that automatic email and SMS requests fail to deliver at all.

exhibits.quote: Send elegant email or text requests straight to your customers.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it sends email or text requests directly to customers.

exhibits.quote: Effectively sends emails and/or txt messages to encourage feedback/reviews
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool effectively sends emails and text messages for feedback.

trials.claim: Use your own domain or subdomain for your survey
trials.claimQuote: Use your own domain or subdomain for your survey
trials.reasoning: A buyer says support helped configure a custom domain, and the vendor lists a custom domain for the feedback link, with no exhibit undercutting it.

exhibits.quote: Support helped me get a custom domain configured.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms custom domain configuration is supported and works.

exhibits.quote: Send from your own email address or Twilio? Custom domain for your feedback link?
exhibits.argument: Vendor pricing lists custom domain for feedback link as an included feature.

trials.claim: Import reviews from Facebook, Google, Trustpilot, Yelp, Foursquare, Tripadvisor
trials.claimQuote: Import reviews from Facebook, Google, Trustpilot, Yelp, Foursquare, Tripadvisor
trials.reasoning: Reviews show Google review collection fails for service-area businesses without a physical address and that the Google Maps connection could not be made to work, materially limiting the claimed imports.

exhibits.quote: Currently, with Feedbacklink you cannot collect google reviews for a business that does not have a physical address on their google my business account (service area business).
exhibits.argument: The quote shows Google review collection fails for service-area businesses without a physical address.

exhibits.quote: Can't get it working with Google Maps and can't get a response.
exhibits.argument: The quote reports Google Maps connection does not work, undermining Google import.

exhibits.quote: It quickly collected our reviews from google maps and trustpilot , and everything is customizable - the review collector page , the flow based on how many stars the user gives, the widgets (there are 3 widgets types)
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the product collected reviews from Google Maps and Trustpilot.

exhibits.quote: Great way to display and showcase your Google My Business & Facebook reviews.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms display and showcase of Google and Facebook reviews works.

themes.summary: Multiple users report emails and SMS are not delivered, go to spam, and integrations no longer connect.

hits.quote: Totally useless, since emails and SMS messages aren't delivered.
I checked several of my own email accounts to see if survey invitations were being sent, but I received nothing.
Almost all the emails and sms we sent were marked as spam.
It will go directly into spam and also looks more like a phishing attack as a Mail you want to send to customer.
The API won’t connect, and the Zapier link says it’s expired.
Zapier indicates that FeedbackLink is not set up on Zapier.
Not working on Hostinger. I have requested a refund for the app.

themes.summary: Several buyers say support stopped replying and the product may no longer be maintained.

hits.quote: I haven't heard back from support even though their chat widget says they'll respond in a few hours.
I have been trying to get support or even documentation. There is NONE.
I then emailed Feedback Link support, but after more than a week, NO RESPONSE from them either.
I have been trying to connect my google maps location for over a month now at different times but I still have not heard from support!
If the software is no longer being actively maintained or supported, please let your customers know

themes.summary: Many buyers say the tool is easy to use and effective for collecting feedback and reviews.

hits.quote: For this purpose, it works like a dream!
Overall, Feedback Link works exactly as advertised.
The platform is intuitive, reliable, and makes it easy to collect and manage client feedback in one place.

themes.summary: Several buyers say the deal is excellent value compared to expensive alternatives.

hits.quote: Ummmm.... this deal crazy good.. For this price?!?!?
An invaluable tool for a very low cost.
Considering how much trustpilot is charging for their widgets, one can't miss feedback.link.

themes.summary: Two reviewers say share links go to a test environment instead of the official link.

hits.quote: If you click on the link you go directly to a test-environment.
The link that opens to be shared with customers directly is a test link and not the official one

themes.summary: Some customers say support was responsive and helpful with setup.
